pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix. The change does what the title says. It has one reasonable design, escaping the LIKE pattern, so no spec was needed.
There is no spec file and no acceptance items.

The new tests would fail without the fix: without ESCAPE, `%25` and `_` match every item. They cover `%`, `_`, and a mix of `%` with other characters. A separate test covers `\`. No tests were deleted or loosened. I could not run them because vitest is not installed in this copy (`npm test` exits 127).
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. I did not search for docs that describe the search.
The escape regex covers `\`, `%` and `_`. The query is still bound as a parameter, and the `ESCAPE '\\'` in the JS string becomes `ESCAPE '\'` in SQL. This is correct.
The query stays parameterized. Escaping only changes LIKE semantics, so there is no injection concern.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.

The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: 3 seeded items plus 2 inserted gives the five items the PR mentions, and the test name matches. The 'CI: not run yet' and 'Reviewer: pending' lines are not checkable from the repository.
